name: Claymorphism
oneLiner: Puffy pastel shapes with inner glow and soft outer shadow, as if every control were pressed from matte clay.

effects.border: none; the clay edge is an inset highlight plus a darker inner base
effects.inner-glow: inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) on top edges, inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.12) on bottoms

motion.reducedMotion: remove the squish scale; keep color and shadow transitions

primary.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -8px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.6), inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45), inset 0 -5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)
primary.hover: transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 28px -10px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.65), inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45), inset 0 -5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)
primary.active: transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px -6px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.5), inset 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)

secondary.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -8px rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.3), inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.12)

default.base: padding: 24px; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -12px rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.3), inset 0 4px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), inset 0 -5px 0 rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.1)
default.hover: transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 22px 36px -16px rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.34), inset 0 4px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), inset 0 -5px 0 rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.1)

default.base: width: 56px; height: 56px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #EDE6FF 100%); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -6px rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.35), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)

height: 52px; width: 100%; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: inset 0 3px 6px rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.18), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(87, 76, 119, 0.3), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)

do: Build depth from an inset top highlight, an inset bottom shade, and one soft outer shadow.
Keep radii at 20–36px and controls pill-shaped; clay has no sharp corners.
Limit the palette to one pastel field plus one saturated accent.
Use 700–800 weights in a rounded family so type matches the material.
dont: Do not pair clay shapes with 1px hairline borders; the outline kills the softness.
Do not add hard black shadows or neumorphic twin-shadow contrast.
Do not use clay for dense tables, code editors, or financial data.
Do not use more than one saturated accent across the page.
antiPatterns: A giant border-radius on flat grey cards with no inner highlight — reads as generic rounded UI, not clay.
Pastel text on pastel backgrounds with 2.5:1 contrast.
Ten different pastel hues so nothing reads as the primary action.

notes: Soft edges hide boundaries; keep a 1.5:1 minimum delta between control and background and always show a 3px focus ring.
Pastel pairs are the main risk: verify text on both the surface and the accent, not just on the page background.
Bouncy easing must be removed under prefers-reduced-motion; scale-based press feedback is the worst offender.
